site.description: A place the source belongs to (a home, a shop, a depot), for grouping questions across places (ADR 0057).

type.description: rtsp: an IP camera relayed by a bridge (ADR 0045). rtmp and bridge_camera are reserved.

status.description: reconnecting: a bridge camera whose bridge is trying to reach it again (ADR 0045). paused: recording and analysis stopped until resumed (POST /v1/sources/{id}/resume).

speaker.description: The camera can play sound (ADR 0069): a phone always, an IP camera when its box found two-way audio (an ONVIF backchannel). Speak is offered only on cameras with a speaker.

talk.description: A person's push-to-talk in live view reaches this camera's speaker (ADR 0069, 0074): a phone with a speaker, or an IP camera whose box can carry live audio to its G.711 backchannel. Hold to talk is offered only where this is true.

capture_url.description: Browser sources: the capture page link (the ticket rides in the URL fragment).

whip_url.description: WHIP sources: the WHIP endpoint (RFC 9725). POST an SDP offer with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

token.description: Browser sources: the capture ticket. WHIP sources: the per-source bearer token. rtsp sources: the bridge token (same as bridge_token). Sensor sources: the integration token (same as integration_token). Shown only here; WHIP, bridge and integration tokens stay valid until rotated or revoked.

expires_at.description: When the ticket expires; null for WHIP tokens, which don't expire.

bridge_id.description: rtsp sources: the bridge carrying this camera.

bridge_token.description: rtsp sources: the bridge's bearer token (`brg_…`). One bridge can carry several cameras.

docker_command.description: rtsp sources: a `docker run` line that starts the bridge with this token. Its `--rtsp` URL is a placeholder unless rtsp_url was given.

integration_token.description: Sensor sources: the bearer token for POST /sources/{id}/readings (Home Assistant and scripts).

ingest.description: Returned only when the source is created or its ingest token is rotated. Not returned when a camera is added to an existing bridge.

retention_days.description: Raw retention override in days; null uses the account value.

retention_mode.description: Overrides the account's retention mode; null follows the account.

retention_max_bytes.description: Fill mode: this source's own byte cap; null shares the account's cap.

sensor_thresholds.description: Per number sense (temperature, humidity, power, ...): sensor.threshold fires when a reading crosses one of these.

max_resolution.description: Highest recording resolution allowed for the account (720p by default; set by the quota provider). Enforced at the source: the capture page requests it, and the media plane refuses a stream above it (error resolution_not_in_plan) instead of transcoding. ADR 0022.

view_changed_at.description: Set when the camera's view no longer matches the one the privacy masks were drawn on (moved, zoomed, or a new aspect ratio); cleared when the masks are saved again. Check the masks.

bridge_id.description: rtsp sources: the bridge carrying this camera.

status_detail.description: rtsp sources: what the bridge last reported, e.g. why it is reconnecting. Credentials are removed.

talk_url_set.description: rtsp sources: the camera's speaker is reached through a talk-back URL instead of its RTSP backchannel (ADR 0075). The URL itself is never shown.

blur_faces.description: Blur faces on this camera (ADR 0068); null follows the account's blur_faces.

blur_plates.description: Blur number plates on this camera (ADR 0068); null follows the account's blur_plates.
